body:
Milestone 9 (`project-pages`): two more project home pages get a figure from their own output.

- `committee-sampling`: exact vs binomial vs Hoeffding majority-capture probability against committee size (section E1; exact zeros not drawn on the log axis).
- `conformal-tolerance`: PAC threshold inflation over the true quantile against calibration size for three Pareto tail indices (section E4).

Each `experiments/figure.py` parses the committed `results.txt`; no number is retyped and no result changed. `python3 site/build.py` prints `ok: 418 projects`. SVGs are well-formed XML (not visually screenshot-checked; no browser module available in this session).
